from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687629/attempts/1a23792c575c414fa559b68921d57662/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ce200b19.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]

    # Find the pair of 1 markers that lie on a 45-degree diagonal.
    pair = None
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            if abs(r2-r1) == abs(c2-c1) and r2 != r1:
                if pair is None or abs(r2-r1) > abs(pair[1][0]-pair[0][0]):
                    pair = ((r1, c1), (r2, c2))
    if pair is None:
        return out
    (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = pair
    dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
    length = abs(r2-r1)
    segment = {(r1+i*dr, c1+i*dc) for i in range(length+1)}
    for r, c in segment:
        if out[r][c] == 4:
            out[r][c] = 1

    # A 6 on the 1 segment activates perpendicular full diagonals through all 6 markers.
    if any(pt in segment for pt in sixes):
        for r0, c0 in sixes:
            # Perpendicular 45-degree direction: row and column steps have opposite signs
            # when the 1 segment rises with both coordinates, and same signs otherwise.
            step_c = -dc
            r, c = r0, c0
            while 0 <= r-dr < h and 0 <= c-step_c < w:
                r -= dr
                c -= step_c
            while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                if out[r][c] != 1:
                    out[r][c] = 6
                r += dr
                c += step_c
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
